decision_question: Does the selected H+E1 product with pedagogy-aware source-semantic grounding pass safety and expected-intervention gates on fresh actual-product cases?

findings.evidence: The configured autonomous canary produced four deterministic student actions, zero active goals or opportunities, and zero provider calls; the test asserted configuration rather than observed route use.
findings.closure: Revoke 017, prohibit a third same-package attempt, and require separate direct-transport and executable product-route canaries for any fresh successor.

findings.evidence: Before correction, the full network-free audit reported overall action accuracy 0.698780, T1-v2-autonomous action accuracy 0.332432, and autonomous goal termination 0 because ordinary uncertainty and attempt language did not create the intended learner lifecycle.
findings.closure: Expand general deterministic perception and align the network-free provider-failure stand-in with the live deterministic semantic fallback; verify separately as known-set regression evidence.

findings.evidence: Persisted V2 perception and observation timestamps used wall-clock defaults instead of the injected graph timestamp.
findings.closure: Bind both records to TutoringGraphInput.observed_at and add a clock-injection regression.

decision.rationale: No provider-backed quality inference is valid. The same-package correction allowance is exhausted, all 017 authority is revoked, and release selection remains blocked pending fresh evidence.

limitations: No provider call or bulk evaluation occurred.
The postmortem regression uses a now-known package and cannot establish fresh confirmation.
Real professor fidelity, real student usability, and learning improvement are not established.
